user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an S3 bucket suitable for hosting application user uploads with appropriate access controls.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: S3 bucket for application user uploads with secure access controls, encryption, versioning, and lifecycle management.

Parameters:
  BucketNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix for the S3 bucket name (will be suffixed with account ID and region for uniqueness).
    Default: app-user-uploads
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,40}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens, 3-42 characters.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment.
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

  NoncurrentVersionRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of days to retain noncurrent object versions.
    Default: 90
    MinValue: 1

  AbortIncompleteMultipartUploadDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of days after which to abort incomplete multipart uploads.
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1

  CorsAllowedOrigins:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Comma-delimited list of allowed origins for CORS (e.g. https://app.example.com).
    Default: 'https://example.com'

Resources:

  UploadsAccessLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${BucketNamePrefix}-${Environment}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AccessLogs

  UploadsAccessLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref UploadsAccessLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt UploadsAccessLogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${UploadsAccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LoggingService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${UploadsAccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${BucketNamePrefix}-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId

  UploadsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS CMK for encrypting ${BucketNamePrefix}-${Environment} user uploads'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3Service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  UploadsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${BucketNamePrefix}-${Environment}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref UploadsKmsKey

  UploadsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DependsOn: UploadsAccessLogsBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${BucketNamePrefix}-${Environment}-${A
